label: Content transport under redesignation: On each edge from an admitted a to v, F v v implies F a v
definition: On each edge from an admitted a to v, F v v implies F a v. This one-way edge-local bridge retains the sentence denotation while changing its actuality coordinate. With successor closure it suffices for the supplied-content rule; it is not required of every individual sentence, whose diagonal premise may fail.
note: Analyst formulation for issue #1049. Neither naming/context policy nor metaphysical applicability is defended. SEP Modal Logic §§10/16 is navigation only; attribution deferred. No new modal calculus or reality claim.
